subject: 邢台开元寺 · 古开元寺菩萨殿（第三殿/释迦牟尼殿），完整正面及四根滚龙石柱
caption: 邢台开元寺 · 菩萨殿
五间硬山殿与四根滚龙石柱正面
source_note: 毗卢殿1988火毁、1997重修，不选。改用明正德十三年重修的菩萨殿及四根有1518铭文的滚龙石柱。须与东侧2013新寺区分。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  SUBJECT: the PUSA HALL (Bodhisattva / Shakyamuni Hall) in the OLD KAIYUAN TEMPLE, Xingtai, Hebei. Use image2 exactly, NOT the new 2013 temple and NOT the rebuilt Pilu Hall. A low broad FIVE-BAY single-storey hall, ONE YINGSHAN hard-gable tiled roof with flush gable end walls and NO hip-and-gable corner wings. FOUR distinct cylindrical stone DRAGON-CARVED porch columns divide the front into five bays; broad grey brick end walls rise to the eaves and have projecting carved plinth-like corner upper mouldings. Lightly outline the spiraling dragon relief on each of the four columns with only a few curves. Preserve very plain long shallow roof and long ridge with two modest end ornaments, four columns, five groups of timber lattice doors and low flat stone step. No second roof. Landscape 1536x1024, centered frontal and entire eave ends and base visible with ample side margins. Remove incense burner in front, both movable metal pots, people, trees, signs, column rail cages and calligraphy. Leave doors white, roof blank with sparse tile hints; thin delicate lines throughout.

facts.label: 现存主体
facts.text: 所绘为古寺第三殿菩萨殿，亦称释迦牟尼殿；明正德十三年（1518）重修。

facts.label: 四柱
facts.text: 殿面阔五间，前檐四根滚龙石柱有1518年铭文，是本图识别重点。

facts.label: 新旧区分
facts.text: 不以1988年火毁后重修的毗卢殿或东侧新寺建筑代表明代原构。
